signal: Tendril launched Tendril Connect V3, a rebuilt outbound platform for faster workflows and scale, alongside near-shore staffing and fractional leadership offerings

email.body1:
Tyler, saw Tendril Connect V3 went live, a rebuilt outbound platform built for faster workflows at scale.

A platform relaunch usually opens more partner and co-sell accounts than a team can cover before everyone ramps, and that partner-sourced coverage is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Tendril's partner ecosystem off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Tyler, quick follow-up for Tendril.

Co-sell motions stall when nobody can work the joint target list fast enough, so partner-sourced accounts sit untouched while the relationship cools. Most teams cannot say how many meetings the partnership actually needs to pay off.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many partner-sourced meetings Tendril needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add people.
email.body3:
Tyler, last bit of proof for Tendril.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Tendril reply rate likely compares to peer sales-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Tyler, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling partner-sourced pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority right now, no problem. A platform relaunch is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page co-sell pilot playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a partner motion? I will tailor it to Tendril either way.
